title: Vault Credentials — Query
description: A filtered, body-free search over stored credentials. At least one of `type`, `communityDid`, `issuerDid`, `purpose` or `status` MUST be present — see the specification; `includeArchived` and `includeDeleted` are modifiers and do not satisfy that requirement.

type.description: Match credentials carrying this VC `type` tag.

communityDid.description: Match credentials held for this community or context DID.

issuerDid.description: Match credentials issued by this DID.

purpose.description: Match the maintainer's semantic classification of the credential.

includeArchived.description: Modifier, not a filter: also return archived credentials matching the other constraints. Absent means false.

includeDeleted.description: Modifier, not a filter: also return soft-deleted tombstones matching the other constraints. Absent means false.

credentials.description: Matching descriptors. Empty when nothing matched — a successful answer, not an error.

CredentialDescriptor.title: Credential descriptor
CredentialDescriptor.description: A body-free projection of a stored credential. Carries no claim content by construction.

id.description: Local handle. Opaque to the consumer; the id `get`, `archive`, `delete` and the rest are keyed on.

types.description: VC `type` tags carried by the credential.

lifecycle.description: Omitted for active credentials, so an active-only result is unchanged by this member's existence.

graceUntil.description: Present iff `lifecycle` is `deleted`. Restorable while now < graceUntil.

CredentialStatus.description: Validity, driven by the credential's own window and by status-list checks. Orthogonal to lifecycle.

CredentialPurpose.description: Semantic classification. `invite`, `membership`, `role`, `endorsement` and `personhood` are defined; a maintainer MAY use another token.

VaultLifecycle.description: Archival state, chosen through this family. Orthogonal to validity.
